languageData.Turret_Tentacle.label: tentacle turret
languageData.Turret_Tentacle.description: A portable tentacle that grows more like a plant. Fires low damage spikes at long range.
languageData.Gun_TentacleTurret.label: turret tentacle
languageData.Gun_TentacleTurret.description: A spike-firing tentacle, defending the colony.
languageData.Bullet_TentTurret.label: tentacle spike
languageData.THeater.label: amor calor
languageData.THeater.description: A tentacle structure that generates heat. Requires no fuel or power, but generates less heat than industrial counterparts. Emits a slightly suspicious odor.
languageData.TCooler.label: amor frigus
languageData.TCooler.description: A tentacle structure that sucks in heat. Requires no fuel or power, but chills the air far below safe limits.
languageData.sphincterdoor.label: sphincter door
languageData.sphincterdoor.description: Divides rooms. This organic tentacle sphincter allows people to move through the door without slowing down, although they may feel a little strange about the process.
languageData.Building_RecyclingPod.label: recycling pod
languageData.Building_RecyclingPod.description: A biological structure that will break its occupant down into component parts, turning it into raw resources. Needless to say, this is fatal for the pawn.
languageData.HiveWall.label: hive wall
languageData.HiveWall.description: An impassable wall. Capable of holding up a roof. This one is crafted from resinous tentacles.
languageData.TentacleWorkbench.label: tentacle workbench
languageData.TentacleWorkbench.description: A workbench equipped with all of the equipment required to craft basic tentacle-related things.
languageData.WombWorker.label: womb worker
languageData.WombWorker.description: Increases work speed when placed near a Tentacle Workbench. One Workbench can utilize up to four Workers. The Worker used to be human, but now they simply act as immobile assistants - storing tools, dispensing liquids, holding products, and softly moaning in pleasure with whatever is left of their brain.
languageData.TendrilDoor.label: tendril door
languageData.TendrilDoor.description: Divides rooms. This organic structure allows people to move through the door without slowing down. It might brush them with a tentacle while they pass.
languageData.TentBeer.label: amornuum
languageData.TentBeer.description: A strange alcohol-like substance. When drunk, induces a "loose" and "relaxed" feeling, as well as minor hallucinations - and an increased drive for sexual activity. Tastes a little bit salty.
languageData.IndoWorm.label: indoctrination worm
languageData.IndoWorm.description: A parisitic worm, implanted in the victim's brain stem. Keeps them content and willing to sacrifice themselves, even under horrible conditions.
languageData.BreedWorm.label: breeding worm
languageData.BreedWorm.description: A parisitic worm, implanted in the victim's brain stem. Causes excessive arousal, significant energy boosts, and will trigger aggressive behavior.
languageData.FeedWorm.label: feeding worm
languageData.FeedWorm.description: A tentacle meant, implanted in the patient's esophagus. Rapidly digests food for them and injects it as a slurry into the stomach. Makes the target immune to gut worms and food poisoning.
languageData.TWombItem.label: in-utero incubator
languageData.TWombItem.description: An Womb implant for Amor Queens which aids in the incubation of Amor Brood Mother eggs.
languageData.TSpecItem.label: anal speculum
languageData.TSpecItem.description: An speculum that permanently forces the rectum further open, allowing for additional tentacle capacity.
languageData.TStomachEItem.label: storage stomach
languageData.TStomachEItem.description: A stomach replacement that lets ingested tentacles handle digestive processes for the Host. This affords the Host with additional tentacle capacity.
languageData.TentacleBroodMother.label: Amor Brood Mother
languageData.TentacleBroodMother.description: A beetle-like Tentacle, dedicated to breeding more creatures for the hive. It has a protective carapace on its thorax as well as several external womb-like body parts for additional egg production. The Amor Brood Mother is the largest of the Tentacle types, and continuously produces Amor Larvae eggs. Those Larvae can then be evolved into other Tentacle types.
languageData.TentacleStinger.label: Amor Stinger
languageData.TentacleStinger.description: A small flying tentacle creature shaped like a ray. It's actually a sleeve of skin, constantly generating and expelling internally generated gases to keep itself afloat. The flexible tail sports a small stinger, capable of injecting a light paralytic venom through even the smallest gaps. Once a target is sufficietly weakened, the tentacle may wrap itself around the head turning them into nothing but a walking flesh puppet. The mind control persists for several hours, after which the victim's head is consumed.
languageData.TentacleWarWomb.label: Amor War Womb
languageData.TentacleWarWomb.description: A walking siege engine tentacle. Has a vaguely humanoid base, but spawns smaller combat larva while bombarding hostile targets at range with sticky semen-based artillery. When constructed for your own colony, will act as a powerful offensive fighter - but can be utilized for defense and area denial, as well.
languageData.TentacleSpawner.label: Amor Spawner
languageData.TentacleSpawner.description: A huge mass of tentacles with a smaller, central female body. The Amor Spawner is entirely dedicated to breeding Squirmers, which Hosts use to fuel their abilities.
languageData.TentacleSquirmer.label: Amor Squirmer
languageData.TentacleSquirmer.description: A long, snake-like tentacle meant to live inside Host bodies. Freezes to death quickly when not inside its native habitat.
languageData.TentacleLarva.label: Amor Larva
languageData.TentacleLarva.description: A small Tentacle in larval form. Doesn't serve any purpose besides evolving into more-advanced Tentacle forms. Research will unlock more advanced forms to choose from.
languageData.TentacleBorer.label: Amor Borer
languageData.TentacleBorer.description: A mass of tentacles that is designed for mining stone and ore. Although since that requires sharp and strong claws, this Tentacle is also effective in combat.
languageData.TentacleGrazer.label: Amor Grazer
languageData.TentacleGrazer.description: A non-combat mass of tentacles that can be butchered for tentacle meat (food) and the soft flesh leather substitute. Essentially livestock.
languageData.TentacleProducer.label: Amor Producer
languageData.TentacleProducer.description: A non-combat mass of tentacles that can be harvested for hard and soft resin resources (per normal animal mechanics) used to build other things.
languageData.TentacleHunter.label: Amor Hunter
languageData.TentacleHunter.description: A combat-focused mass of tentacles, designed to protect the hive from external threats with debilitating ranged attacks.
languageData.TentacleAbductor.label: Amor Abductor
languageData.TentacleAbductor.description: A non-combat mass of tentacles, designed to target downed enemies and transport them to the hive as prisoners. Can perform general hauling tasks as well.
languageData.TentacleDefender.label: Amor Defender
languageData.TentacleDefender.description: A combat-focused, male humanoid tentacle, designed to protect the hive from external threats with powerful melee attacks and the ability to absorb high amounts of damage.
languageData.TentacleValkyrie.label: Amor Valkyrie
languageData.TentacleValkyrie.description: A combat-focused, female humanoid tentacle, intended as a vanguard striker for the hive. Has powerful attacks, some psychic abilities, and can spawn minion tentacles to swarm enemies. When constructed for your own colony, will emit one of several psychic auras that will buff nearby friendly pawns or debuff nearby hostiles.
languageData.TentacleBrewer.label: Amor Brewer
languageData.TentacleBrewer.description: A mass of tentacles that produces drugs and chemicals regularly. Will attack with tox gas and cum sprays.When constructed for your own colony, can be switched between several products to brew
languageData.TentacleStriker.label: Amor Striker
languageData.TentacleStriker.description: A combat-focused mass of tentacles, designed to latch on to and incapacitate hostile enemies with attacks to their genitalia.

languageData.TentacleBorer.tools.1.label: right mass of clawed tentacles

languageData.AmorQueenEgg.label: Amor Queen egg
languageData.AmorQueenEgg.description: An Amor Queen Egg. Can be inserted into a pawn, where it will hatch and progressively take over the body, transforming them into an Amor Queen host.\n\nNOTE: This transformation will only work on female pawns. It will cause lethal organ instability in males.
languageData.AmorBaronEgg.label: Amor Baron egg
languageData.AmorBaronEgg.description: An Amor Baron Egg. Can be inserted into a pawn, where it will hatch and progressively take over the body, transforming them into an Amor Baron host.\n\nNOTE: This transformation will only work on male pawns. It will cause lethal organ instability in females.
languageData.AmorBroodMotherEgg.label: Amor Brood Mother egg
languageData.AmorBroodMotherEgg.description: A huge egg produced in the womb of an Amor Queen Host. Hatches into an Amor Brood Mother, a core component of a tentacle colony. Protect it!
languageData.AmorSquirmerEggUnfert.label: Amor Squirmer egg (unfert.)
languageData.AmorSquirmerEggUnfert.description: An unfertilized Amor Squirmer tentacle egg.
languageData.AmorSquirmerEggFert.label: Amor Squirmer egg (fert.)
languageData.AmorSquirmerEggFert.description: A fertilized Amor Squirmer tentacle egg.
languageData.AmorLarvaEggUnfert.label: Amor Larva egg (unfert.)
languageData.AmorLarvaEggUnfert.description: An unfertilized Amor Larva tentacle egg.
languageData.AmorLarvaEggFert.label: Amor Larva egg (fert.)
languageData.AmorLarvaEggFert.description: A fertilized Amor Larva tentacle egg.
languageData.HardResin.label: hard resin
languageData.HardResin.description: Hard tentacle resin. It is immune to fire, and while it is brittle, when dried it can be forged into hard and sharp shapes. It is perfect as a material for cutting tools or weapons as well as structures.
languageData.SoftResin.label: soft resin
languageData.SoftResin.description: Soft tentacle resin. Pretty and immune to fire, but structurally weak. Unsuitable for weaponry or walls, but still a useful construction material.
languageData.TentacleLeather.label: soft flesh
languageData.TentacleLeather.description: This skin is amazingly soft and feels like genital skin. Probably because it is...
languageData.TentacleSlime.label: tentacle slime
languageData.TentacleSlime.description: A sticky, viscous substance "produced" primarily by Amor Queens. Used for crafting more advanced eggs and implants. It lasts indefinitely, so long as it is stored safely. An extremely valuable resource!
languageData.TentacleCatalyst.label: tentacle catalyst
languageData.TentacleCatalyst.description: The condensed genetic essence of a human being, ripped out of their flesh by a Recycling Pod. Used to craft other Tentacle and Host forms, as well as advanced equipment and implants.
languageData.BossGlandBrewer.label: Brewer gland
languageData.BossGlandBrewer.description: A gland, extracted from Amor Brewer hybrids. It's squishy and slimy, and feels still alive.\n\nThis can be analyzed to unlock additional research, which will allow you to use the gland to craft advanced things, as well as your own Brewers.
languageData.BossGlandBrewer.comps.CompAnalyzableUnlo: By studying the Brewer gland, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) : {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.
Can be analyzed by a colonist.
languageData.BossGlandValkyrieDefender.label: twinned gland
languageData.BossGlandValkyrieDefender.description: A twinned gland, extracted from Amor Defender and Amor Valkyrie hybrids. It's squishy and slimy, and feels still alive.\n\nThis can be analyzed to unlock additional research, which will allow you to use the gland to craft advanced things, as well as your own Valkyries and Defenders.
languageData.BossGlandValkyrieDefender.comps.CompAnal: By studying the twinned gland, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) : {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.
Can be analyzed by a colonist.
languageData.BossGlandWarWomb.label: War Womb gland
languageData.BossGlandWarWomb.description: A gland, extracted from Amor War Womb hybrids. It's squishy and slimy, and feels still alive.\n\nThis can be analyzed to unlock additional research, which will allow you to use the gland to craft advanced things, as well as your own War Wombs.
languageData.BossGlandWarWomb.comps.CompAnalyzableUnl: By studying the War Womb gland, {PAWN_labelShort} has acquired the insight needed for the research project(s) : {RESEARCH}.\n\nYour researchers can now use research benches to begin researching how to actually use the technology.
Can be analyzed by a colonist.
languageData.Filth_Slime.label: tentacle slime filth
languageData.TentacleCollar.label: tentacle collar
languageData.TentacleCollar.description: A large tentacle, curled tightly around the wearer's neck, used in controlling slaves. The tip goes over the wearer's mouth, hindering their ability to eat. Once settled, a small tendril will be extended inside the mouth, and will secrete drugs that provide a mild euphoric effert, suppressing the slave's resistance, increasing their sex drive, and making them more docile. Not nearly as invasive as an Indoctrination Implant.
